concept: Trying something new even when you might fail or look silly
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character worries about looking silly trying something new, and tries anyway
exercise.reflection_prompt: What happened after the character tried, even with the risk of looking silly?
exercise.practice: Student names one thing they'd like to try even though they might not be good at it right away

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific thing they're willing to try
